e393ec14c9.q: What is GoFundMe's Smart Fundraising Coach and how does it help people create fundraisers?
e393ec14c9.a: The Smart Fundraising Coach is an AI agent designed to help people tell their story in the right way by filling in all necessary details and coaching them through the entire fundraising process—from creating a fundraiser to marketing it and ensuring they get the resources needed. It was built to help people like a stressed parent outside a hospital who needs to raise money but lacks fundraising expertise.

7bf0f7d086.q: How has the cost of building products changed with AI, and what does this mean for product experimentation?
7bf0f7d086.a: The cost of building is going down dramatically—potentially approaching zero cost soon. This means you can make much larger bets on experiments and try five different radical changes to your service simultaneously across different audiences, whereas before you had to build small, observe, and then make bigger bets based on signal.

52eeab899a.q: Does artificial intelligence need human taste and judgment to build good products, or will AI eventually replace that?
52eeab899a.a: Taste and human judgment are becoming even more important in the age of AI, not less so. While you can now build systems that radically change your service and test them at scale, human judgment will always be needed to decide which bets to make. Historical pattern recognition shows that every technology revolution made more problems worth solving, requiring more humans, not fewer.
